privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Blobs (25K)' image is a standard Fiji sample. Valid threshold methods include: Default, Huang, Intermodes, IsoData, Li, MaxEntropy, Mean, MinError, Minimum, Moments, Otsu, Percentile, RenyiEntropy, Shanbhag, Triangle, and Yen. The output must be a CSV at /home/ga/ImageJ_Data/results/threshold_comparison.csv with exactly 4 columns: Method, Threshold, Count, and Total_Area, containing at least 4 rows of data.
